questions.question_text: Write the number 13205.17268 correct to 3 significant figures
Write the number 13205.17268 correct to the nearest 10.
Solve 4x - 3 = 15
Solve 1 - 2x = 11 - 4x
Work out (1.7)^2 - \sqrt{8.5}
Work out \frac{7}{12} - \frac{1}{3}
The exchange rate between pounds (£) and Chinese yuan (¥) is £1 = ¥8.3. Change £549 to Chinese yuan.
Find the value of A when x = 7, y = 12.5 and h = 6, given that A = \frac{1}{2}(x + y)h
Rearrange the formula A = \frac{1}{2}(x + y)h to write x in terms of A, y and h.

The diagram shows a wooden cuboid with a cylinder removed. The cuboid has length 22 cm, width x cm and height x cm. The cylinder has length 22 cm and diameter 5 cm. The volume of wood remaining after the cylinder has been removed is 976 cm^3. Find the value of x.
Xiong flies by plane from Manchester to Hong Kong. The distance from Manchester to Hong Kong is 9000 km. The flight takes 12.5 hours. Calculate the average speed of the plane.
The plane leaves Manchester at 2045. The local time in Hong Kong is 8 hours ahead of the local time in Manchester. Find the local time in Hong Kong when the plane lands.
Translate triangle A with vector \begin{pmatrix} 0 \\ -8 \end{pmatrix}. Label the image C.
Describe fully the single transformation that maps triangle A onto triangle B.
Rotate triangle B through 90° clockwise with centre of rotation (-6, 2). Label the image D.
The table shows the marks of each of 10 students in a physics exam and in a chemistry exam. Find the mean physics mark.
Find the equation of the regression line for y in terms of x.
Use your answer to part (b)(i) to estimate the chemistry mark when the physics mark is 46.
Two of the students who scored more than 35 in the physics exam are chosen at random. Find the probability that they both scored more than 65 in the chemistry exam.
Sketch the graph of y = f(x) for values of x between -3 and 3, where f(x) = \frac{4x - 3}{2x + 1}.
Write down the equations of the 2 asymptotes of the graph of y = f(x).
Write down the coordinates of the points where the graph crosses the axes.
Solve the inequality \frac{4x - 3}{2x + 1} > 2 - x.

Paula bought a house on 1 January 2023. On 1 January 2024 the value of the house increased by 10%. On 1 January 2025 the value of the house increased by 6% of its value on 1 January 2024. The value of the house on 1 January 2025 was $215710. Calculate the amount Paula paid for the house in 2023.

From 2025 the value of the house increases exponentially at the rate of 6% each year. The value of the house on 1 January 2025 was $215710. Find the year in which the value of the house on 1 January will first be greater than $400000.
Use a graphical method to solve 5 \times 0.8^x = 2x + 7. Give your answer correct to 2 decimal places.
y varies inversely as the square root of (x - 1). y = 1 when x = 5. Find y in terms of x.
w varies directly as y^2. w = 45 when y = 3. Use your answer to part (a) to find w in terms of x. Give your answer in the form w = p(x - 1)^q, where p and q are constants.
The area of triangle ABC is 74.4 cm^2. AB = 12.4 cm and angle ABC = 30°. Show that BC = 24 cm.
Find AC.
Find obtuse angle CAB.
Triangle XYZ is similar to triangle ABC. The area of triangle XYZ is 62 cm^2. Find YZ.
The diagram shows a quadrilateral ABCD. ABCE is a rhombus and CDE is a right-angled triangle. AC = (2\sqrt{3})x and BE = 2x. Show that AE = 2x.
Find, in terms of x, the perimeter of ABCD.
